name: Tithe Auditor
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The auditor can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the auditor has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The auditor makes two Ledger Slap attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Heavy Ledger Strike.

Actions.name: Ledger Slap
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Heavy Ledger Strike
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* 21 (6d6) Bludgeoning damage.
Actions.clause: makes you drop what you are carrying
Actions.expresses: making prey drop what they carry

lore: Born of ledgers never balanced and tolls never paid, the Tithe Auditor drifts through floors and walls to collect from the living the debt it can never settle in death, dropping what they carry into its grave-horde.

generation.userConcept: a tax-ghost that makes you drop what you are carrying

clauses.text: makes you drop what you are carrying

generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
monsterDescription: a tax-ghost that makes you drop what you are carrying
